run_stable_signature_evals: run the stable signature evaluation script to compute image metrics and watermark bit accuracy on a directory of images
run_get_img_metric: run get_img_metric to compute SSIM, PSNR, and Linf scores comparing watermarked images against originals
run_cached_fid: run cached_fid to compute Fréchet Inception Distance between two image directories with caching support
run_get_bit_accs: run get_bit_accs to evaluate watermark bit and word accuracy under various image attacks using a message decoder
run_get_msgs: run get_msgs to decode hidden watermark messages from images using a message decoder under various attack conditions
